newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end flat, wait for U.S. data, weekend.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end flat, wait for U.S. data, weekend.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended steady on Friday, as investors were cautious ahead of U.S. payroll data to be released later in the day and squared positions ahead of the weekend, brokers said. They added that although blue-chips were lacklustre, there was interest in laggard issues.
The 225-share Nikkei average finished at 20,485.75, down 2.40 points or 0.01 percent at 20,485.75. Its June futures added 30 to end at 20,500.
"The U.S. data and upcoming June futures and options expiry were good excuses for investors to move over to the sidelines on," said Kunihiro Hatae, Tokyo Securities general manager.
